description: NaTaO₃ is (Cubic) Perovskite structured and crystallizes in the cubic Pm̅3m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to twelve equivalent O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight equivalent TaO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.79 Å. Ta⁵⁺ is bonded to six equivalent O²⁻ atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent TaO₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ta-O bond lengths are 1.97 Å. O²⁻ is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Ta⁵⁺ atoms.
